create_running_statistics: create a RunningStatistics module to compute running mean and standard deviation for a given dimension
update_running_statistics: update the RunningStatistics module with new tensor data to incrementally compute mean and variance
normalize_tensor: normalize a PyTorch tensor using the RunningStatistics mean and standard deviation
denormalize_tensor: denormalize a PyTorch tensor back to original scale using RunningStatistics mean and standard deviation
clear_running_statistics: clear the RunningStatistics state to reset the running mean and variance counters
